spacing_rule.note: x → bearing → the ray meets the run line (the sink's counter, its longest edge) through the fixture's plan point; the along-run gap between two fixtures vs the plan's. Hand measurement noise on the 2026-11-06 kitchen views was about ±15-20 cm, hence ±30. A ray within 20° of the run line is skipped. Each pair's tolerance = tol_cm + the along-run shift a ±bearing_noise_deg misreading of x causes for both fixtures (root-sum-square), so a far, oblique view gets a wider band and a near, square view a tight one.
